title: Partner Utility Program Schedule: Public-Way Restoration Rates for Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Partner Utility Program Schedule: Public-Way Restoration Rates

Partner programs schedule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Public-way partner schedule rate: a plan enrolled through Lakeshore Water Authority whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the public-way partner window takes the Lakeshore public-way rate; a plan enrolled through Riverbend Municipal Utilities whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the public-way partner window takes the Riverbend public-way rate; every other plan takes a public-way partner schedule rate of one. Public-way windows counted in months run back from the day the payment is booked: an entry falls within a public-way window when fewer whole months than the window separate its posting date from that day. The public-way partner schedule rate multiplies the plan's public way restoration allowance in the public-way restoration figure.

## Schedule

| Partner utility on the plan | Utility-bill premium remittance posted within the 12-month public-way partner window | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Lakeshore Water Authority | yes | 1.1 (Lakeshore public-way rate) |
| Riverbend Municipal Utilities | yes | 1.05 (Riverbend public-way rate) |
| Lakeshore Water Authority or Riverbend Municipal Utilities | no | 1 |
| any other utility, or direct enrollment | either | 1 |

## The window

12 months counted back from the day the public-way restoration payment is booked; a premium payment posted with the utility bill as its method is inside when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from that day.

*Hypothetical boundary cases (payment booked 20 October 2026):* a remittance posted 21 October 2025 is inside the window; one posted 20 October 2025 is not.

## Hypothetical example

Riverbend Municipal Utilities plan with a utility-bill remittance last month and an allowance of $4000.00 assumed: $4000.00 multiplied by 1.05 is $4200.00.
